label.zh: 时之螶插曲（顺序不定）
label.en: Episodes of the Worm (any order)

note.zh: 环形神殿开放/研究后（worm_events_available）解锁；各插曲按自身触发条件发生，可能全部、部分或都不发生；终章不要求读完它们。
note.en: Unlocked by opening or studying the Loop Temple (worm_events_available). Each starts on its own trigger; any, all or none may happen, and the finale does not require them.

note.zh: 镇压选项360天后随机其一（random_list 75/25）。
note.en: One of these 360 days after choosing suppression (random_list 75/25).

note.zh: “扰乱仪式”项目完成时随机其一。
note.en: One of these when the Disrupt project completes.

note.zh: 选择继续监视360天后随机其一。
note.en: One of these 360 days after choosing to keep monitoring.

note.zh: 击毁朔望号后由隐藏事件9318按条件三选一。
note.en: Hidden event 9318 picks one of these when the Syzygy is destroyed.

label.zh: 拒绝信号
label.en: The signal declined

note.zh: 不开启事件链；获得物理研究，首位科学家获得场论操纵专长与药物滥用特质。
note.en: No event chain begins; a physics research reward, and the first scientist gains field-manipulation expertise and the substance abuser trait.

label.zh: 无视重现的信号
label.en: The reprise ignored

note.zh: 结束事件链“信号”；获得物理研究，第二位领袖获得特质。
note.en: The Signals chain ends; physics research, and the second leader gains traits.

label.zh: 不理第三次呼唤
label.en: The third call let go

note.zh: 结束事件链“信号”；获得物理研究，第三位领袖获得特质。
note.en: The Signals chain ends; physics research, and the third leader gains traits.

label.zh: 结局：时之螶之爱
label.en: Ending: the love of the Worm

note.zh: 母星系行星变为墓穴世界、恒星化为黑洞，主要物种特质与宜居偏好被改写；时之螶事件结束。
note.en: The home system's planets become tomb worlds and the star a black hole; species traits and habitability preferences are rewritten; the Worm story ends.

label.zh: 结局：粉碎圆环
label.en: Ending: the Shattered Loop

note.zh: 击败时之螶化身：获得能源与物理研究，拥有远古遗物时得到遗珍“螶之鳞”，并开启庆典局势。
note.en: The Worm's avatar is defeated: energy and physics research, the Worm Scales relic with Ancient Relics, and a celebration situation.

label.zh: 圣仆的最后使命
label.en: The Retainer's last duty

note.zh: 支付800能量与800矿物后，无限神机熔毁，黑洞旁出现新的生命并留下社会学资源点。
note.en: After paying 800 energy and 800 minerals the Infinity Machine burns out; new life appears near the black hole, leaving a society deposit.

akx.9021.zh: 第三位领袖：浪子号归来

akx.8888.zh: 调试测试事件（游戏中不触发）

notes.zh: 这是开发者调试用的测试事件（is_test_event = yes，trigger = always = no），正常游戏中不会出现；保留在此仅为完整收录原文。
notes.en: A developer debug event (is_test_event = yes; trigger always = no) that never appears in normal play; kept only so the original text is archived.

notes.zh: 开局时隐藏事件akx.8000以4/20的权重（约20%的对局）选定一个黑洞星系；首个非格式塔、非游牧的玩家帝国由科学家率领的舰队进入该星系时触发，全局仅一次。
notes.en: At game start hidden event akx.8000 designates a black-hole system with weight 4 of 20 (about one game in five). The first non-gestalt, non-nomadic player empire to enter it with a scientist-led fleet receives this event, once per game.

notes.zh: 前三个问题是对话内选项（is_dialog_only），可在同一窗口依次询问；其余选项结束通讯。狂热和平主义的劝降不会开战，而是获得“朔望”号。
notes.en: The first three questions are in-window dialogue (is_dialog_only) and can all be asked; the other options close the channel. The fanatic pacifist surrender offer avoids the battle and grants the Syzygy.

notes.zh: “不行”选项带有default_hide_option（窗口被关闭时的默认选项）；“以后再说”或“不行”之后，舰队再次进入该星系会触发“圣仆再临”。
notes.en: "No" is marked default_hide_option (the default when the window is dismissed). After "No" or "Perhaps later", a later fleet visit triggers "The Retainer, Again".

akx.9310.evidence: events/horizonsignal_events.txt:1548-1638 a/b/c are is_dialog_only with response_text (one-time research rewards guarded by their own flags); d/e/f options (events/horizonsignal_events.txt:1640-1820) close the channel: all but d.fanaticpacifist fire 9315 (fanatic-authoritarian e via 9312).

scope.zh: 全部78个文档：开局选定、三次信号与领袖、环形神殿、五个插曲（信使、命中相会、神之圆环、时螶之界、圣仆）、终章两结局；隐藏路由、延迟、随机权重与状态触发均对照源文件。
scope.en: All 78 docs: game-start designation, the three signals and leaders, the Loop Temple, the five episodes (Messenger, Rendezvous, Coils of God, Waiting World, Retainer) and both finale endings; hidden routers, delays, random weights and state triggers checked against the source.

uncertain: default_hide_option on 9600.d / 9610.b is read as the hidden default for a dismissed window; the reader still lists it as an option.
akx.8888 is a debug test event kept in the family because excluding it would create a separate root story; see ledger request.
Observer-mode notifications observer.70/71/72 are suppressed from the tree and therefore unassigned in coverage.
